name: Light Pillar
description: Full-area WebGL2 background of a glowing, twisting vertical light pillar with a two-color gradient, bloom, grain, intro reveal, pointer parallax and click pulses.
contents: Container div with a single WebGL2 canvas rendering a raymarched pillar of light
behavior: Pillar rotates and flows continuously, speed set by rotationSpeed and flow
Intro animation grows and reveals the pillar over about 2 seconds
Pointer movement leans, spins and shifts the pillar when interactive
Clicking spawns a light pulse travelling along the pillar axis, up to 3 at once
Resolution adapts automatically when frame rate drops and recovers later
Rendering stops when offscreen, tab hidden, paused, or idle
Reduced motion preference disables animation, intro, pointer and pulses
Light mode renders the glow as ink on a white background
editableByProps: Brightness, glow amount, bloom, grain and edge fade
Pillar width, height scale, tilt, twist and detail level
Rotation speed, flow speed, pause, intro on or off
Pointer interaction and click pulses on or off
Render quality or explicit resolution scale
Blend mode, light mode, extra className and inline style

needsCodeEdit.where: aim multipliers for state.spin, state.lean and state.shift in the frame function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pillar shape or glow math

fixed: Root is absolutely positioned and fills its nearest positioned parent, which must have a size
Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable or shaders fail
Listens to pointermove and pointerdown on window, so pointer effects work even over content above it
Uses a screen blend by default, which suits dark backgrounds
Reads colors through a canvas, so colors must be valid CSS color strings
Rotation does not run when rotationSpeed is 0
Heavy GPU raymarching; pixel ratio capped at 2 and adaptive resolution floor is 0.25 scale
Intro, pointer and pulses are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
